deck.note: Shuffled deck. Server deals from here and cuts.

hand.note: Each player's dealt hand (6 cards, reduced to 4 after discard).

crib.note: Dealer's extra hand built from discards. Hidden until show phase.

cut_card.note: The starter card cut from the deck after discards.

play_pile.note: Cards played during pegging. Running total must not exceed 31.

played_cards.note: Cards a player has played during the current pegging round.

pegboard.note: Score counter per player. First to 121 wins. Represents position on a 121-hole pegboard.

discard.note: Used cards collected after each hand.

card.note: Standard French playing card. pip_value used for pegging and 15-counting (face cards = 10). rank_order used for run detection (A=1 low only).

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Server shuffles and deals 6 cards to each player.

phases.name: discard
phases.note: Each player selects 2 cards to discard to the crib. Simultaneous to prevent information leakage.

phases.name: cut
phases.note: Server reveals one card from the deck as the starter. If Jack (his heels), dealer scores 2.

phases.name: pegging
phases.ends_when: all cards played or both players say go
phases.note: Players alternate playing cards to a running total (max 31). Score for pairs, 15s, runs, 31, go, last card.

phases.name: show
phases.note: Pone scores hand first, then dealer hand, then dealer crib. Each scored with the cut card. Score 15-combos, pairs, runs, flushes, nobs.

his_heels.definition: If the cut card is a Jack, the dealer immediately scores 2 points.

nobs.definition: A Jack in hand matching the suit of the cut card scores 1 point.

fifteen.definition: Any combination of cards summing to 15 (using pip values) scores 2 points.

pair.definition: Two cards of the same rank score 2 points. Three of a kind = 6 (3 pairs). Four of a kind = 12 (6 pairs).

run.definition: Three or more cards in consecutive rank order score 1 point per card.

flush.definition: Four cards of the same suit in hand score 4 (5 if cut card matches). In the crib, all 5 must match for 5 points.

pegging_fifteen.definition: Playing a card that brings the running total to exactly 15 scores 2 points.

pegging_pair.definition: Playing a card matching the rank of the last card played scores 2. Three matching = 6. Four matching = 12.

pegging_run.definition: Playing a card that completes a run of 3+ with the most recently played cards scores the run length.

thirty_one.definition: Playing a card that brings the total to exactly 31 scores 2 points. Count resets to 0.

go.definition: If a player cannot play without exceeding 31, they say 'go'. Opponent continues until they also cannot. Last player to play scores 1 (unless they hit 31).
